Class AbstractRequirement

java.lang.Object
io.github.kaivian.klibrary.requirement.impl.AbstractRequirement
All Implemented Interfaces:
Requirement
Direct Known Subclasses:
ChanceRequirement, CooldownRequirement, GamemodeRequirement, HasExpRequirement, HasLevelRequirement, HasMoneyRequirement, HasPermissionRequirement, InventoryHistoryRequirement, InventoryOpenRequirement, ItemRequirement, PlaceholderRequirement, WorldRequirement
public abstract class AbstractRequirement extends Object implements Requirement
Abstract base class for requirement implementations.

Provides common utilities, service access, and support for accept/deny action handlers. When a requirement is evaluated, the appropriate handler actions are automatically executed.

Features:

  • met() / notMet(String) — result factory methods
  • Accept/deny action handlers — executed after evaluation
  • Service provider access for dependency-gated requirements

    • evaluateAndHandle

      public RequirementResult evaluateAndHandle(ExecutionContext context)
      Evaluates the requirement and executes the appropriate handler actions.

      This method calls Requirement.evaluate(ExecutionContext) and then runs the accept or deny actions based on the result.

      Parameters:
      context - the execution context
      Returns:
      the evaluation result
